description.ko: 레이어 내 텐서를 GPU 간 분할
description.en: Split tensors within layers across GPUs

advantages.en: Less storage per rank for partitioned tensors

disadvantages.ko: 복제 텐서·GPU 연결·집단 통신 비용 확인 필요
disadvantages.en: Account for replicated tensors, GPU connectivity and collective communication

advantages.ko: Expert 가중치와 연산 부하를 rank별로 분산
advantages.en: Distributes expert weights and computation across ranks

disadvantages.ko: 토큰 이동·Expert 부하 불균형·통신 backend 지원 확인 필요
disadvantages.en: Account for token transfers, expert load imbalance and communication backend support

advantages.ko: 연속된 레이어의 가중치와 연산을 stage별로 배치
advantages.en: Places consecutive layers and their computation in separate stages

disadvantages.ko: Stage 간 전송·처리 시간 불균형·pipeline bubble 확인 필요
disadvantages.en: Account for inter-stage transfers, uneven processing time and pipeline bubbles
